content.text: Digital creators in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted face significant challenges when setting up online stores. The frustration of not being able to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how-5|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-my-unfiltered-take-2|payment]]s for your digital products can stifle growth and innovation. However, COREMERCH offers a straightforward solution through a fully operational infrastructure that you can deploy for free on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-2|Cloudflare R2]] Pages. This guide will walk you through the process of establishing your digital store without the reliance on conventional payment processors.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment processors are often inaccessible in many regions, leaving creators without viable alternatives. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is built on sovereign principles, ensuring you own everything after deployment. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you bypass the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, giving you full control over your digital commerce environment. This approach is robust, scalable, and designed specifically for creators who demand reliability without dependence on third-party services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start the deployment process, ensure you have a Cloudflare account set up, as well as access to GitHub. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, which will facilitate your backend logic. You’ll also need a NOWPayments account to handle crypto payment processing efficiently. Organize your digital products, ensuring they are ready for upload, and prepare your marketing materials for when your store goes live. This preparation streamlines your deployment and sets the stage for success.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, begin by configuring NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency transactions. Integrate this with your Google Apps Script to automate payment confirmations and product delivery. Use Cloudflare Pages for hosting your storefront, ensuring that your GitHub repository is correctly linked. This step ensures that when a payment is made, the customer receives their digital product instantly and seamlessly. Testing this pipeline thoroughly before going live is crucial to ensure a smooth customer experience.
You own everything after deployment — no third-party control.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital products across your networks and direct traffic to your Cloudflare Pages URL. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure payments process smoothly and products are delivered as expected. Use the insights gained from these initial sales to refine your offerings and marketing strategies. This is where you will truly see the power of your sovereign commerce infrastructure in action.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your digital store is live, consider scaling your operations to accommodate more products and customers. Utilize the features of Cloudflare Workers and Supabase to enhance your store's capabilities, allowing for better data management and customer interactions. Explore the Edge Commerce Stack for additional tools and support, ensuring that your infrastructure remains agile as your business grows. The goal is to continuously optimize and expand your offerings without losing control over your digital commerce environment.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by setting up a Cloudflare account and leveraging the NOWPayments integration. This allows you to create a robust payment processing system without relying on traditional platforms. The Sovereign Blueprint guides you through setting up the necessary infrastructure to get started quickly.
Deploy Stack 02 in just 48 hours with comprehensive support.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Explore related searches like 'github pages digital store crypto payments free hosting' to deepen your understanding of hosting options. For those looking for an all-in-one solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers comprehensive features for a fully operational digital store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting your digital product store. They allow you to create a reliable and efficient storefront without traditional payment processing limitations.
What types of digital products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, software, templates, and more. The infrastructure is designed to efficiently handle various digital goods and ensure smooth transactions.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, after deploying with COREMERCH, you will receive 30 days of support to help you address any issues or questions that arise as you begin selling your digital products.
